checks.description: The JSON object's `checks` reduced to id and status.
checks.title: Checks

codes.description: Issue codes reported: the codes of the JSON object's `errors` then its `warnings`, in order (so a valid scenario's warnings appear here), or the [CODE] tags found in the text of standard error then standard output.
codes.title: Codes

files_written.description: Sorted paths of the files the command left in the directory besides the inputs.
files_written.title: Files Written

headline.description: For `validate` in text mode, the first line of standard output; null otherwise.
headline.title: Headline

json_keys.description: Sorted top-level keys of the JSON object on standard output.
json_keys.title: Json Keys

ok.description: The JSON object's `ok`, when it has one.
ok.title: Ok

stderr_has_issues.description: Standard error contains a [CODE] issue line.
stderr_has_issues.title: Stderr Has Issues

stdout_kind.description: json when standard output is one JSON object, text when it has other text, empty otherwise.
stdout_kind.title: Stdout Kind
